basis: Reka ScrollArea parts render an unroled viewport and scrollbar — the component's obligation is scrollable-region-focusable, a browser-tier rule the sweep judges.

interaction.basis: a scroll surface around content — the scrollbar and the scroll trap are its own contract.

exceptions.because: no harness spec yet — keyboard passage through the scrolled content is unproven in browser; the spec lands with the interaction-evidence tranche
